title: Efficiency of cooperation incentives in evolutionary population games under payoff-observation errors
summary: Traditional studies on evolutionary dynamics of cooperation have concentrated on an idealized game setup free of payoff-observation errors. However, in real-world scenarios, individuals frequently encounter errors when observing the payoffs of their opponents during game interactions, resulting from unintentional mistakes, such as data misrecording, overlooking critical details, and miscalculations.
